decisions.decision: Did not auto-approve the plan 09-04 Task 1 checkpoint despite AUTO_MODE=true
decisions.rationale: AUTO_MODE's human-verify auto-approval is meant for simple confirmatory checkpoints; this checkpoint's entire purpose is collecting real, unfabricated Livestatus/MQTT behavior from a live Checkmk 2.4.0p35 site (RESEARCH.md Assumptions A1-A4). Auto-approving would defeat the plan's stated purpose ('nothing here is done until a live site says so').

context_notes: Phase 9 (poller-core) is a 4-wave, 4-plan phase with a strict dependency chain (09-01 -> 09-02 -> 09-03 -> 09-04). Waves 1-3 executed via bm:gsd-executor subagents in isolated git worktrees, merged back to main one at a time (no-ff merges, STATE.md/ROADMAP.md backed up and restored around each merge to avoid last-merge-wins clobbering), with the full pytest suite (284 tests) re-run and passing after every merge. Wave 4 (plan 09-04) is intentionally non-autonomous (autonomous: false) and its Task 1 is a blocking human-verify checkpoint that cannot be run in this sandbox (no podman/broker/Checkmk site here). The executor was spawned, correctly identified this, modified nothing, and returned the checkpoint verbatim. Execution is otherwise unaffected by unrelated pre-existing uncommitted changes in the working tree at session start (deleted .planning/HANDOFF.json, modified .planning/config.json, untracked docs/src/, screen1.png, .planning/.pending-auth-captures.jsonl) — those predate this session and were left untouched throughout, except this HANDOFF.json write itself.
